scope_guards: The authoritative current register capacity is retained once at 1,089 homes.
The 2022 Section 73 variation is part of the same development lineage and is not a second 1,089-home scheme.
The 51 and 5 additional-flat components sum to a proposed 56-home uplift and are not counted twice.
The proposed 56-home uplift is not used to overwrite the current 1,089-home record without reconciled final evidence.
Phases 1 and 2 construction/occupation evidence is partial delivery and not whole-scheme completion.
Commercial, employment, gym and community floorspace are not dwellings.
A point with blank geometry and non-public ownership category do not establish exact HMLR title topology.
No score or promotion is written without updated final capacity, exact completion, title relation and executed overlays.
